scope: Untimed inspected-input diagnosis of repeated structural pairs within individual sweeps; every predicate query still executes; no performance claim
driver_source:
"""Count repeat structural predicate queries without suppressing any query."""

import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, "/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src")
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter, workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import FAMILIES, TOPOLOGIES, WIDTHS, fixture
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import commutation

ROOT = Path.cwd()
HEAD = "50633d8b469969bbfd95bad94d38583cce95a1cd"
OUT = Path("/private/tmp/fq-commutation-pair-census-20261122.json")
RAW = Path("/private/tmp/fq-commutation-dispatch-inspected.json").read_bytes()
quality = json.loads(RAW)
reference = {
    (row["case"], row["workflow"]): row
    for row in quality["rows"]
    if row["variant"] == "baseline"
}
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True, timeout=20).strip() == HEAD
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], timeout=20)
original_sweep = commutation._sweep_commutation
original_predicate = commutation.commute
CAPACITIES = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64)


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()


def structural(instruction):
    return instruction.name, instruction.wires, instruction.matrix is not None, bool(instruction.params)


report = {
    "scope": "Untimed inspected-input diagnosis of repeated structural pairs within individual sweeps; every predicate query still executes; no performance claim",
    "source_head": HEAD,
    "reference_sha256": hashlib.sha256(RAW).hexdigest(),
    "capacities": CAPACITIES,
    "driver_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "driver_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "rows": [],
    "completed": False,
}
with OUT.open("x") as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")

for width, family, topology in itertools.product(WIDTHS, FAMILIES, TOPOLOGIES):
    ir_source = fixture(width, family, topology, "01" * 32)
    identity = f"{width:02d}/{family}/{topology}"
    for workflow in ("flagquantum-ordinary-restored", "flagquantum-target-artifact"):
        sweeps = []

        def sweep(ir):
            queries = 0
            hits = {capacity: 0 for capacity in CAPACITIES}
            caches = {capacity: OrderedDict() for capacity in CAPACITIES}

            def observe(left, right):
                nonlocal queries
                key = structural(left), structural(right)
                answer = original_predicate(left, right)
                queries += 1
                for capacity, cache in caches.items():
                    if key in cache:
                        assert cache[key] == answer, "The proposed structural key does not determine the answer"
                        hits[capacity] += 1
                        cache.move_to_end(key)
                    else:
                        if len(cache) == capacity:
                            cache.popitem(last=False)
                        cache[key] = answer
                return answer

            with patch.object(commutation, "commute", observe):
                result = original_sweep(ir)
            sweeps.append({"instruction_count": len(ir.instructions), "predicate_queries": queries, "hits": hits, "analysis_summary": result.summary()})
            return result

        row = {"case": identity, "workflow": workflow, "status": "failed", "sweeps": sweeps}
        try:
            config = workflow_configuration(workflow)
            adapter = load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={"options": {"sdk": config["sdk"], "workflow": workflow, "compiler_options": config}}))
            with patch.object(commutation, "_sweep_commutation", sweep):
                payload = adapter.execute("route", ir_source, 11)
            observed = digest({key: payload[key] for key in ("operations", "final_layout")})
            prior = reference[identity, workflow]
            assert observed == prior["payload_sha256"] and dict(adapter.audit) == prior["audit"]
            row.update(status="matched accepted archive", payload_sha256=observed, audit=dict(adapter.audit))
        except Exception as error:
            row.update(error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error))
        report["rows"].append(row)
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(identity, flush=True)

report["summary"] = {}
for workflow in ("flagquantum-ordinary-restored", "flagquantum-target-artifact"):
    selected = [row for row in report["rows"] if row["workflow"] == workflow]
    report["summary"][workflow] = {
        "executions": len(selected),
        "failures": sum(row["status"] != "matched accepted archive" for row in selected),
        "sweeps": sum(len(row["sweeps"]) for row in selected),
        "predicate_queries": sum(sweep["predicate_queries"] for row in selected for sweep in row["sweeps"]),
        "hits": {capacity: sum(sweep["hits"][capacity] for row in selected for sweep in row["sweeps"]) for capacity in CAPACITIES},
    }
report["completed"] = True
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], timeout=20)
print(json.dumps(report["summary"]), flush=True)
assert all(row["status"] == "matched accepted archive" for row in report["rows"])
